ticks.note: `clean` during the brew. `Serving`'s during action records the request in `cleanWanted`, and the brew carries on: `Heating` moves to `Pouring`.
Pouring. The request is remembered although `clean` has been released.
The cup is done (`cups` is 1) and the chart is back in `Ready`, the safe point. `Ready` was entered in this tick, so its delayed transitions wait for the next one.
Commit: `if cleanWanted go to Stopped` fires, `Stopped` is final, so `Serving` terminates and its join clears `cleanWanted` and enters `Cleaning`, all in this tick.
`brew` and `clean` in the same tick, in `Ready`. The during action writes `cleanWanted` before `Ready` reads it, and `Ready` tries `if cleanWanted` first: cleaning wins, the brew request is ignored.
